Hi Elena — thanks for sending the intake materials and the sample PO. A few specifics from Finance so you have clarity for processing: 

- Default onboarding term: Net 60 (initial 60-day payment lag while we validate TAX/W-9 / compliance items).
- Accelerated transition: we can move to Net 45 after 60 days provided invoices and CLM evidence are clean (no recurring disputes).
- Early-pay program: Net 30 option available via our EarlyPay portal. Current fee schedule (standard pricing): 1.25% of invoice for Net 30 from settlement date; fee collected by our finance partner (you will see a single remittance amount net of fee). We price early-pay dynamically for very large invoices — if you expect >$250k/month we can discuss tiered rates.

What we need from ThermoWave to accelerate activation by 2026-06-10: 
1) Completed vendor intake form (ThermoWave_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) with TAX ID populated.
2) PO example must include the Redwood PO number in the header (we will provide this once the contract is in our system).
3) Signed W-9 or equivalent (for non-US vendors: W-8BEN / VAT registration).
4) Primary remit contact and remit email for your AP team.

Portal link to enroll in EarlyPay and upload tax docs: https://app.redwood.com/payments/onboarding/thermowave 

Once we receive the intake form and tax doc we’ll issue a temporary PO number for testing so your invoices won’t be rejected during ingestion. If ThermoWave wants the Net 30 early-pay option for the kickoff invoice, select EarlyPay on the portal and we’ll process that settlement cycle (fee will be applied).

Cheers,
David Kim
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
